explorer.description: Interactive type-relationship graph (Cytoscape): types grouped by namespace, implements and inherits edges, member details on click.
explorer.input: N-Triples or Turtle using the dt: ontology

reads.nodes: subjects typed dt:Class, dt:Interface, dt:Struct or dt:Enum
reads.labels: dt:name on types, namespaces, members and parameters
reads.grouping: dt:inNamespace plus dt:name on the namespace
reads.edges: dt:implements and dt:inherits between exported types
reads.details: dt:hasMember; member dt:name and dt:returnType / dt:propertyType / dt:fieldType / dt:eventType; dt:hasParameter, dt:parameterType, dt:ordinal

explorer.limits: Stays responsive to roughly 1,500 type nodes. Types without an rdf:type in the export are not drawn, and edges to them are dropped.
explorer.requiresNetwork: Loads cytoscape and n3 from public CDNs when opened.
explorer.copy: "Copy for Claude" copies the drawn types (or the selected type) plus the database and query they came from as roslyn-graph-selection/2 JSON; "JSON" downloads it.
